name: Stencil
description: A stencil: the letter-shaped opening, with the bridges left in so it holds together.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 52%, #000 52%), repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0 8%, transparent 8% 46%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 52%, #000 52%), repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0 8%, transparent 8% 46%); -webkit-mask-composite: source-over; } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
